title: 040 architecture amendment -- option 3 (shared LSTM + an LSTM per task head, NNMT_LS / LSTM_STACK) vs option 1 (shared LSTM + MLP head per task, NNMT_LR / LSTM_RAW), same 24 indicators, operating point, label, task weights and exits
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26). Added after mt_op's verdict and BEFORE any mt_lr / variant result was read. Not an R7 candidate: R7 (preregistration_models.json) is unchanged; a PASS here is reported and substituting mt_ls for the selected model is the user's call.
why: user question 2026-10-21: which of (1) shared LSTM + MLP heads, (2) separate LSTM per task, no shared trunk, (3) shared LSTM + LSTM per task is best. (2)'s trading head never sees the auxiliary losses, i.e. it is the trading-head-only twin already pre-registered (preregistration_framework.json, suffix TR); only (3) needs a new arm.

stages.screen: train and evaluate mt_ls on f00-f07 ONLY (the late half stays untrained and unread for mt_ls). PASS if: 8 records with trades; mt_ls model share >= min_model_share on f00-f07; pooled early gain vs mt_lr > 0; paired verdict over f00-f07 maps to pass; both risk verdicts map to pass. INCONCLUSIVE under the same conditions as judge_one (control < min_control_trades, no fold changed, an inconclusive map).
stages.confirm: ONLY if the screen passes: train f08-f14, then judge_one(mt_ls, mt_lr) with the models rule over f00-f14 (early and late gain > 0, paired and risk not WORSENED). A PASS (or |delta| < seed_rule_pp) needs seed 2 of mt_ls and mt_lr before it is reported as a result.
